days.hook: Social sector jobs and internships in one place
points: Open Opportunities on impact-connect.in

reviewed.note: Live app: Opportunities lists jobs, internships, fellowships, contracts and freelance projects from official sources with a Type filter first. Site's own words: it verifies the published source and review date but is not the employer and does not guarantee role, selection or salary; apply only through the official source after checking current rules. Script mirrors this and claims nothing more.

reviewed.note: Live app: Learn lists resources with provider, type, access and cause fields, marked Official source reviewed; includes free The Open University OpenLearn courses (access: Free), e.g. Introducing the voluntary sector and leadership practice. reviewed.note: Live app: Volunteering lists opportunities with organisation, state/district, SDG cause filter and official source links with verified dates. Consent flow copy: volunteer re-confirms which private fields may be shared; approved details are shared privately. Script mirrors this consent model without promising placements.
